title: Digital quantum state preparation by nucleation
summary: Quantum state preparation is crucial for quantum algorithms, and improved state preparation methods can reduce resource requirements by orders of magnitude. In this work, we introduce a state preparation method for lattice Hamiltonians on digital quantum computers inspired by nucleation. In our method, the exact ground state of a small lattice Hamiltonian is prepared in a quantum circuit, then a series of growth stages are performed via Trotterized adiabatic evolution to increase the size of the lattice to the desired model.
